verdict.rationale: Polar documents payout thresholds and balance visibility (polar-docs-14, polar-docs-15), a full typed API/SDK (polar-docs-23, polar-docs-38), webhooks, and a remote MCP server letting agents access 'products, customers, subscriptions, orders, benefits' (polar-supp-mcp). However, there is no explicit documentation of a balance-transaction/ledger API endpoint, nor confirmation that the MCP server or SDK exposes payout/balance data specifically (the MCP scope list omits payouts/balance), so reconciling deposits to charges via an agent is only indirectly supported. Missing for 10: explicit balance-transaction API endpoint docs, MCP/agent access to payout and balance data, and any documented reconciliation workflow or example.
